title: Ancient terrestrial civilization with near-luminal travel
summary: Eric Hazeline tells of Ancient terrestrial civilization with near-luminal travel, about hundreds of millions of years ago at Earth, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: Eric Hazeline, introduced on Jesse Michels's podcast as a former leader at the National Security Agency, the US spy agency for communications, co-wrote a book with Chris Gilbert called The New Science of UFOs. He says one idea they explore is that an advanced civilization lived on Earth hundreds of millions of years ago, able to travel close to the speed of light, and that its traces were erased as the planet's surface slowly reshaped itself. If true, some visitors might not be alien at all, but from Earth's own deep past.
